Defines startup latch, animation rate, loop transition, and abort.

facts.rationale: Replaces the baseline's misleading interpretation of isDrawn with the helper's exact command, pointer, and constructor-result guards.
facts.value: Consumes command 2 while x0.x is zero by setting the latch to 1 and clearing the command, then reapplies specialn_anim_rate. isDrawn attempts arrow creation only when command 0 equals 1 and arrow_gobj is absent, clearing the command before the attempt. Its true result means that creation failed. On false, the callback updates geometry and enters SpecialNLoop when startup frames finish, restoring callbacks and animation processing. On creation failure, it unsets the arrow and x14 references and calls ft_8008A2BC. An existing arrow does not select the failure branch.

facts.rationale: Preserves the verified guarded reference transition while correcting the baseline's characterization of the trailing query as shared article bookkeeping.
facts.value: Does nothing for a null game object, missing Fighter, or absent arrow reference. Otherwise clears arrow_gobj. If boomerang_gobj and x14 are also null, calls ftLk_Init_BoomerangExists and discards its result. That callee only tests boomerang_gobj and performs no bookkeeping mutation. Repeated calls remain no-ops until another arrow reference is installed; this helper does not itself destroy the item.
